purpose: qualify real PipelineV2 previous-stage valid enables and nonuniform state lifetimes; no formal graph PPA
user_decision: preserve released state-bank evidence; collect a prospective native-protocol synthetic-bank successor with the old model as fixed baseline
old_tests_role: all prior independent labels permanently excluded; released coefficients/receipts only
clock_scope: same three exact contexts; 750/2250/4500/13500ps and formal targets remain unqualified until a separate prospective extension
geometry: independent scalar channels start at a registered cut and survive for one or more stages; at least one full chain; no arithmetic or formal-case topology copied
native_protocol: single clock, synchronous active-low reset; valid1<=iv; validN<=valid(N-1) always advances; every data capture at stage s enabled by iv at s=1, otherwise valid(s-1); same across all words at a cut
known_bits: all dynamic, high-zero padding, or one rotating known-zero hole; include generic5-bit/four-variable and65-bit/64-variable masks; no known-one constants or dependence between different channels
grouping: whole synthetic source and every exact clock/stage variant in one split; independent test changes packing/lifetimes/masks/reset context, not unseen widths
features_excluded: mapped FF/buffer counts, STA/area, case/source/split identifiers, formal or previously consumed independent PPA
area_label: complete state-bank standard-cell area minus kept postcapture parity observer; includes valid/hold/reset logic and clock/tap/unassigned port repair; no arithmetic area charged
selection: nonnegative unweighted train-only NNLS with no intercept; complete validation banks ranked by original gates, MAE/mean actual, serialized size, stable name; released coefficients are immutable candidate only
input_enable_label: iv primary-port to first-stage data D arrival difference excludes input-delay arrival; retain full path/slack/points

boundary.input_H: T-0.2T-input_to_D-slack, excluding the registered I/O delay once
boundary.register_overhead: max train/validation nonnegative register H + max registered data/control QD +50ps
boundary.input_overhead: max frozen register overhead and max train/validation input H + max input-enable delay +50ps
boundary.test_gate: at every exact target freeze must cover independent maxima with the same ownership; never adapt reserve from test
boundary.scope: native-protocol synthetic state-bank control/hold paths; joint arithmetic/formal boundary remains separately required

capacity_pilots_role: registered train data; no fitting on separate capacity or formal PPA
mapping_reuse: t0 ABC mapping reused byte-exact for t1/t2; fresh SDC/ODB, all leaves paid
software_preflight: native projected/materialized/RTL audit; deterministic actual RTL reset/bubble/old-valid and arbitrary-lifetime simulation before EDA
